status: author-directed draft; ranks 2-4 design-only until an approved campaign needs them
model: Astral Projection is an astral-domain superskill: each rank is a model of reality, a set of perceptions and a set of permissions, not simply more minutes outside the body.
duration_status: provisional caps; the author has not approved final durations

ranks.name: Disorientation
ranks.understanding: Unfamiliar with the Astral. Assumes physical laws still apply. No QIP or Law of One framework.
perception: Near Astral with a physical overlay
physical objects appear warped or symbolic
may not distinguish dream from waking projection
capability: separation of the Astral Body from a stationary, vulnerable physical body
walking and basic observation as if using ordinary physics

ranks.name: Lucidity and dream navigation
ranks.understanding: Realises that physical laws and geometry do not govern the Astral; begins to grasp QIP in practice; understands that dreams are constructed from quantum information.
perception: dream worlds under construction by sleeping agents
the astral is responsive to attention and imagination
capability: fast movement and flight without physical locomotion
deliberate access to the Lower Astral and inner dream environments
witnessing sleeping agents create dream worlds

ranks.name: Conscious Agent Network
ranks.understanding: Recognises that solid astral objects are rendered quantum information exchanged among Conscious Agents, and begins to perceive agents as information-bearing structures.
perception: agents as information structures rather than fixed shapes
the exchange of Related Organized Thought Energy
capability: Transmit Information (ROTE): send and receive organised conceptual packages inside the Astral
Learn Ident: acquire and recognise a known agent's persistent noetic identity

ranks.name: Authorised informational agency
ranks.understanding: Understands that the interface renders quantum information, energy and matter differently, and begins to perceive wave functions and collapse as the setting's QIP ontology depicts them.
perception: the difference between a projected appearance and its underlying information
the informational structure of a rendered scene
capability: read, write, edit and delete quantum information within the character's authorised scope only
Use Ident: instant astral travel to a known agent's astral presence
malleable self-owned information; constructed limbo worlds may be editable where the scene says who owns them

ranks.name: Cosmological research
ranks.understanding: Understands Noöspace as a fictionally interpreted infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, encounters Law of One higher-plane interpretations, and dimly perceives alternative timelines and dimensions.
capability: entry to the Devachanic, Etheric and Buddhic planes
authored research into other timelines and dimensions
advanced astral navigation and interface adaptation

techniques.name: Transmit Information
techniques.summary: Send or receive Related Organized Thought Energy: condensed thought, concept, image, feeling and memory as one packet.
techniques.not: Not SWN Telepathy, not a spoken message and not an automatically interpretable download.

techniques.name: Learn Ident
techniques.summary: Acquire and recognise the persistent noetic identity of a known conscious agent.
techniques.not: Not a name, body or address; reveals neither physical position nor consent.

techniques.name: Use Ident
techniques.summary: Relocate the Astral Body instantly to a known agent's astral presence, subject to plane access and AntiPSI constraints.
techniques.not: Not SWN Teleportation, not physical travel, and not available from a learned Ident alone.

prohibitions: no physical or Cyber power at any rank
no second Astral Combat skill or astral hit-point pool
no free write access to another agent's information, a protected mind or a secured system
no automatic time travel, resurrection or omniscience
no claim that present-day physics establishes consciousness-caused collapse or timeline merging
